method: v7.3: 60% priority (Goals cosine; 10% DREAM-title blend when both exist; DREAM titles proxy when Goals missing) + 25% KSE geo + 15% social_capital (mss_network floor + named/explicit-ask + twinning + shared donors). Complementary DREAM↔Challenges and basin stay separate layers.

storage.matchingEdges: Slim compact JSON: core score fields + track + operational_score. Full pairwise matrix kept for lab ranks (test-known-pairs).
storage.richCacheNote: Local only (gitignored). Regenerated by yarn export-matching-edges.
storage.packagesAndSignals: On thematic/operational slices + mss-candidates.json — not on every matrix row.

warning: Product unit is an МСС candidate agreement (package theme·form), not a strategy twin. Unverified hypotheses unless known=true / status=registry_known. Combined score ranks one discovery signal — use package + signals / slice files. suggested_theme / suggested_form / package are IMC hypotheses, not registry facts. matching-edges.json is slim (scores); browse packages via mss-candidates / slices.

tracks.thematic: goals_cosine >= p90 (0.401) and geo_score <= 0.35 — cold-start vision partners
tracks.operational: geo_score >= 0.85 and not thematic — convenient service co-sharers; slice ranked by operational_score (geo + fiscal_similarity + dream_overlap) when available

socialCapital.note: 0.15 slot is social_capital (readiness). mss_network stays the KSE|Пліч pairwise field. Never known=true from twinning/donors/named.

operationalBoost.note: Extra fields on edges; do not fold sector-tag dream_overlap into combined score

mssSuggest.note: Rule-based theme + legal-form package (mss_suggest.py); does not change score; never sets known=true

mssCandidate.note: Normalized candidate wrapper (mss_candidate.py): kind/package/signals/discovery_primary/status. Signals are discovery evidence, not IMC legal forms. Thin browse sidecar: mss-candidates.json

operational.note: Neighbours not already linked in the KSE МСС network

dreamPriority.note: DREAM project-title cosine fills the 0.60 priority slot when a side lacks Goals (dream_proxy / mixed). Small 10% blend when both have Goals. Not sector-tag Jaccard. Complementary layer unchanged.
